lines.text_source: These Valkyries came up with the same contrived story for everyone but, you know what? We didn't die to be part of any war of the Gods. Your General Brigard seems like a sensible man. I believe he hopes to find the “Guardian” with another goal in mind. Do you really think it'll be able to take you back? To be quite honest with you, I very much doubt this Guardian even exists.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.intent: questionar a narrativa das Valquírias e expressar dúvida sobre a existência do Guardião; avaliar a competência de Brigard
lines.base_translation: Essas Valquírias inventaram a mesma história cansativa para todo mundo, mas, sabe de uma coisa? Não morremos para fazer parte de nenhuma guerra dos Deuses. Seu General Brigard parece ser um homem sensato. Acredito que ele tenha outro objetivo em mente ao procurar o
